title: Weighted latency + path-health failover with model-variant fallback
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a production-ready region selection and failover policy that uses a composite latency+network-health score (not just p95) and can automatically route requests to cheaper/compatible model variants when regional health degrades. Goal: reduce user-visible latency and error spikes during transient network degradation while preserving cost controls and avoiding noisy reroutes. The implementation must include: 1) a scoring pipeline that ingests p50/p95 latency histograms and network health signals (error rate, TCP resets, small-window packet loss), 2) a region-ranking algorithm that applies configurable weights and time-decay, 3) per-tenant routing policies with tiers (low-latency vs cost-optimized) and 4) an automated fallback to lighter model-variants (quantized or lower-context models) with strict correctness rules and circuit-breakers.
acceptance_criteria: Composite score produced every 10s and stored in the routing store for all active regions
Region rank changes only after threshold crossing observed across 3 consecutive windows (10s windows) or manual override
Failover to alternate region reduces p95 tail by >= 20% in synthetic degradation tests without increasing error rate > 0.5%
Model-variant fallback triggers for configured routes and reduces average token cost by >= 15% in simulated overload scenarios
Canary rollout demonstrates no customer-visible regressions for 5000 synthetic QPS and is rollbackable via console toggle
Documentation and runbook published with safe-mode kill-switch and SLO rollback steps
design_decisions: Use a 3-window EWMA weighting (1m/5m/15m) for p50 and p95 to be responsive but not flipping on noise
Composite score = normalized_p95*0.5 + normalized_p50*0.3 + normalized_network_error*0.15 + capacity_penalty*0.05
Normalize each signal to [0,1] using dynamic baselines per-region (percentile baseline computed over the prior 7 days to accommodate diurnal patterns)
Implement CUSUM-based regime detection to avoid reacting to single-window spikes; require sustained deviation before full failover
Model-variant fallback is policy-driven: route-level opt-in, allowed variant list, and a per-tenant budget guard to avoid runaway cost or quality regressions
algorithm_summary: Compute EWMA for p50/p95 per-region over 1m/5m/15m windows
Normalize against 7-day baseline percentiles and clamp outliers
Score = weighted sum (configurable weights) with penalties for <=10% spare capacity
Apply hysteresis: require score delta > threshold for N consecutive windows before changing primary region

When score exceeds failover_threshold, attempt: 1) route to altitude-tier within same region (if available), 2) fallback to adjacent healthy region, 3) if region capacity-limited, fallback to allowed model-variants per-route
All routing changes emitted into audit log and traced to request-level for postmortem
testing_plan: Unit tests for normalization and scoring functions with synthetic histogram inputs
Integration test injecting synthetic latency/error signals into canary region and asserting routing changes
Chaos test: simulate 30s network partition between regionA and control plane; validate failover + rollback behavior
Load test with mixed model variants to measure cost and quality delta
E2E test: deploy canary to 5% production traffic, observe metrics for 48h before ramping
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (dev): library and scoring pipeline behind feature flag (internal traffic)
Stage 2 (canary): enable for non-critical routes + synthetic traffic in us-west-2, monitor 72h
Stage 3 (gradual ramp): +5% real traffic per day with automated rollback on alerts
Stage 4 (ga): enable by default for eligible routes and publish console controls for per-tenant policy
runbook_actions: If unexpected global failover occurs: toggle 'routing-safe-mode' to sticky-primary for 15m
If model-variant fallback causes quality regressions: disable variant for tenant and revert routing to last-known-good region
For noisy flips: increase hysteresis window and mark suspected region as degraded in console
Escalate to SRE and PM with trace links and recent score history
